silo_cell.name: Silo fill cell — west bay
silo_cell.purpose: Fills cartons with granular product and sends them on to packing.
silo_cell.sequence: A conveyor indexes an empty carton along the belt. An inductive prox sensor sees it arrive under the silo spout and the belt stops, leaving the box in position. A solenoid gate in the silo discharge opens and product runs into the carton. A through-beam photo-eye across the mouth of the box makes when it is full, the gate shuts, and the belt indexes the full carton out and the next empty one in.
silo_cell.panel: START and STOP on the operator panel latch and drop a seal-in rung; a maintained E-STOP kills it outright. RUN, FILL and FULL lamps report which part of the cycle the processor believes it is in — which is not always the same as what the machine is doing, and that gap is the job.

mps_line.name: MPS transfer line
mps_line.purpose: Moves and sorts workpieces between stations.
mps_line.sequence: Stations hand parts along the line under their own interlocks.
mps_line.panel: Each station carries its own START, STOP and E-STOP.
